PHP 7.4 引入了箭头函数 `fn`。根据 PHP 官方文档：

"Arrow functions are a short-circuit form of closures. They do not explicitly bind using `use`, but implicitly bind any variable from the current scope in the process of creating the function."

```php
$x = 10;

```
